summary: Chrome Extension v6.4.0 Testing Complete - All backend APIs working correctly. Extension download endpoint returns valid zip with v6.4.0 manifest. All 23 vendors detected in popup.js. All dimension patterns (7), SKU patterns (9), and finish/color detection patterns (11) verified present. Frontend loads and displays projects correctly.
passed_tests: Chrome extension download endpoint returns 200 OK
Download returns valid zip file with correct content-type
Zip contains manifest.json, popup.js, popup.html, content.js
GET /api/projects returns 200 with list of projects
Projects have required fields (id, name) for extension dropdown
POST /api/extension-scrape accepts scraped data and returns success

All 23 vendors detected in vendorMap: fourhands, uttermost, globalviews, rowefurniture, reginaandrew, bernhardt, loloirugs, visualcomfort, hvlgroup, vanguardfurniture, flowdecor, crestviewcollection, bassettmirror, eichholtz, safavieh, surya, zeelighting, hubbardtonforge, hinkley, elegantlighting, gabby, arteriorshome, curreyandcompany
Dimension pattern: Rug format (2'3" x 7'9") present
SKU pattern: Four Hands subtitle (.text-neutral-50) present
SKU pattern: Four Hands URL (/product/) present
SKU pattern: Visual Comfort title pattern present
SKU pattern: Generic patterns (SKU, Item, Style, Model) present
Projects list displays with multiple projects
Project detail page loads with all tabs (Questionnaire, Walkthrough, Checklist, FF&E, etc.)
critical_code_review_comments: Chrome Extension v6.4.0 correctly implements comprehensive multi-vendor support with 23+ vendors in vendorMap
Seven dimension detection patterns cover all common formats: WxDxH, Width/Height/Depth labels, HxWxD, rug format, Overall format
SKU detection includes vendor-specific logic for Four Hands (subtitle + URL), Bernhardt (URL), HVL (URL), Visual Comfort (title), plus generic patterns
Finish/color detection covers: dropdown text (.truncate), swatch images (label[title]), selected/active states, aria-selected, background-image swatches, HVL finish codes
Four Hands swatch logic prioritizes: 1) subtitle color name, 2) dropdown display, 3) truncate elements, 4) selected swatch labels, 5) matching swatch by color name, 6) first valid swatch fallback
